annotations: Water Street NW, the last 0.09 mi before the Capital Crescent Trail, Georgetown, Washington DC: 2 ways rated LTS 4 from the Whitehurst Freeway's count and speed. Proposed: LTS 1 beside the separated track, LTS 2 on the painted-lane piece (our levels, by the side-street and painted-lane rules).

value.public_note: Water St NW at the Capital Crescent Trail: a separated track alongside, on a two-lane street that ends at the trail, so 1. DDOT's 2020 layer says 4.

rows.reason: The owner, 2026-11-13: "water street is definitely not a high stress road and it connects to the CCT". Our level from the street's own facts, confirmed by the owner 2026-11-13 ("1 by the track, 2 by the lanes"); The 37,593 cars a day (DDOT, 2024) and the 35 mph on these ways belong to the Whitehurst Freeway block overhead (the ways carry its TIGER names, K St / Whitehurst Fwy / US 29), not to Water St, a two-lane street that ends at the Capital Crescent Trail.
